content: We cannot directly compare the perplexity scores BERT model with a unidirectional LSTM model as both are calculated in a different manner. We can experiment to compare it with a Bi-directional LSTM or use a downstreaming task to compare both the performances. We could also randomly mask tokens and then compare the prediction accuracy on the masked tokens.
